title: MOASYS-Vault — output/plex/<library>/collection-changes/<time>.json
description: The journal `npm run collections -- --apply` writes before its first change and updates after each one. `--undo <this file>` reverses the steps marked done.

generated.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the run.

mode.description: `apply` worked from a review file; `undo` reversed an earlier journal.

server.description: The Plex server's machine identifier. An undo refuses a journal from another server.

source.description: The review file (apply) or journal (undo) the run worked from, relative to the project.

kind.description: Create a collection, add items to one, or take one item out.

collection_key.description: The collection's rating key. Null for a create that hasn't run yet.

rating_keys.description: The items this request adds or removes.

items.description: The review-file lines (or item titles, for an undo) behind this request.

status.description: `planned` until it runs. A run stops at the first `failed`.
